# STUR Physics Lab — AI/LLM information

> STUR-ROLL: Lambda-CDM plus one derived sector that predicts the CMB
> birefringence angle from integers, |beta| = k alpha / 2 with k = 1,
> i.e. 0.2091 deg, with no continuous parameter fitted.

## Scope
- Not a theory of everything and not a replacement for Lambda-CDM or GR.
- Gravity is TEGR (= GR): passes GR precision tests by construction.
- The new sector carries <~1e-7 of the dark-matter energy; all other
  cosmological observables are those of Lambda-CDM.

## Key files
- /README.md — overview, scoreboard, falsification
- /docs/HYPOTHESIS.md — derived chain, status, audit A–E
- /docs/PREDICTIONS.md — beta(l) tables and LiteBIRD kill criteria
- /docs/STATUS.md — what is derived, assumed, missing, open
- /src/stur_final.py — reproducible computation (numpy, scipy; ~30 s)
- /results/stur_final_output.txt — captured output

## Superseded
- /archive/v7-toe/ — the former STUR v7.0 "Theory of Everything" material,
  kept for the record. It is NOT the current claim.
- /archive/genesis-v10-stur-b/ — the earlier STUR-B birefringence bridge
  hypothesis (one fitted parameter), excluded by STUR-ROLL.
